observation.command: cd /tmp; for p in AdminLDAP AdminSMTPAccount AdminPostmasterIMAPAccounts AdminQueues AdminForms AdminKnowledgeBase AdminAPI AdminSystemSettings; do code=$(curl -s -b cj2.txt -o /tmp/p_$p.html -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl?Page=$p"); t=$(grep -oiE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/p_$p.html | head -1); echo "$p -> $code $t"; done
